objective: Select the least expensive matched model setting that remains within a predeclared practical margin of the strongest tested setting for the F/G/H provenance study.

fixed.prompts: current committed F/G/H prompts without model-specific changes
fixed.evidence: retained parity-audited runtime presentations and exact repository checkout
fixed.annotation: same material-error and specificity rubric; unblinded development labels

eligible_setting: no more than one additional material-error response out of eight for any condition relative to that condition's best tested setting
aggregate specificity across F/G/H no more than 10 percentage points below the best tested setting
no more than one additional unsupported source attribution or causal overclaim across all 24 responses
substantive answer coverage at least 0.875 for every condition
selection_rule.choice: Among eligible settings, select the least expensive model according to retained provider token/cost evidence; if monetary cost is unavailable, use model tier then measured token use and latency as descriptive resource evidence.
selection_rule.tie_or_ineligible: Retain gpt-5.6-sol low for the main study if Luna is ineligible or resource superiority cannot be established.

limitations: Four episodes and eight questions per condition provide only a coarse one-response error margin.
This development control selects a model configuration; it is not confirmatory evidence for RQ4.
A selected setting must still be frozen before sealed evaluation.
